definitions.explanation: The reproductive unit of a plant, containing the embryo and stored nutrients. A more formal or scientific term compared to the everyday word {種|たね}.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{種子|しゅし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧種|きぐしゅ}→絶滅危惧種：04642_zetsumetsukigushu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種子|しゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are facilities for preserving the seeds of endangered species.

notes:
USAGE:
{種子|しゅし} is the formal or scientific term for seeds. In everyday conversation, ⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧ is more common. {種子|しゅし} appears frequently in botany, agriculture, and environmental contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {種子|しゅし}⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ (seed plant)
- {種子|しゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to preserve seeds)
- {種子|しゅし}{島|しま} (Tanegashima — note: different reading たね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しま)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧: seed — the everyday word, also means cause or material
- ⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧: fruit, nut — the mature seed-bearing part of a plant
